build_efficientnet_model: build an EfficientNet model from a config dict using build_model with custom model_params
build_preset_efficientnet: build a preset EfficientNet model by passing a config with name like efficientnet_b0 through b7
test_efficientnet_forward: test the EfficientNet model forward pass by passing a random torch tensor of shape (10, 3, 260, 260)
test_build_model_config: test building an EfficientNet model using either model_params or model_name in the config dict
get_model_config: create an EfficientNet model config dict with width_coefficient, depth_coefficient, resolution, and dropout_rate params
